problem: ObjectNav research is fragmented across many datasets, evaluation metrics and method families, with no comprehensive review consolidating them.
motivation: ObjectNav combines visual perception, semantic prior learning and visual navigation, making it a challenging and emerging Embodied AI task. A systematic overview of datasets, metrics and methods is needed to orient new researchers and identify open directions.
key_idea: A survey that reviews the widely used ObjectNav datasets and evaluation metrics, analyzes recently developed methods, and outlines future research directions.
insight: Only the abstract was available, so no analysis or ablation findings can be reported. The abstract frames ObjectNav as an integration of perception, semantic priors and navigation.
method: Datasets review: surveys widely-used ObjectNav datasets
Metrics review: covers the corresponding evaluation metrics
Methods review: in-depth review and analysis of recently developed ObjectNav methods
Future directions: discusses potential research directions
numbers_note: abstract only; survey with no own results
results: Survey paper with no experimental results reported in the abstract. It offers a comprehensive review of datasets, metrics and methods for ObjectNav, plus future directions.
limitations: Only the abstract was available, so details of the taxonomy and conclusions could not be extracted.
As a 2023 survey, it does not cover later LLM/VLM-based ObjectNav methods.
